source_name: CRM — Регистар на годишни сметки / поднесување годишна сметка (annual accounts register)
why_relevant: Single central electronic repository of annual accounts for MK legal entities; filing is compulsory. Gives revenue, result and headcount trajectories for local banking/payments software vendors and for MK subsidiaries of foreign vendors — the only systematic quantitative competitor signal for private companies.

source_name: CRM — Регистар на вистински сопственици (Beneficial Ownership Register)
why_relevant: Operational since 27 Jan 2021 under the AML/CFT law, run by CRM jointly with the Financial Intelligence Office. Reveals the natural persons behind MK-registered payments/IT companies and behind local partners of foreign vendors — key for spotting proxy entities, resellers and undisclosed group links. Searchable by ЕМБС or partial name.

source_name: CRM — Статистички билтен од Трговски регистар и Регистар на годишни сметки
why_relevant: Aggregated registry statistics combining trade-register and annual-accounts data — sector/activity-level totals that let you size the MK IT/payments vendor population and benchmark an individual competitor against its НКД class without buying every statement.

source_name: CRM e-Submit / eFiling portal (е-поднесување, регистрациони пријави)
why_relevant: The electronic filing front-end for registrations and changes in the Trade Register. Documents the exact registration/branch procedures and the registration-agent requirement — useful to interpret registry timestamps (when a foreign vendor's MK branch was actually filed vs. announced) and to understand what fields exist to be queried.

source_name: CRM — Резервација/проверка на назив на правен субјект (name reservation)
why_relevant: Name reservation precedes incorporation. Checking whether a foreign payments brand's name has been reserved in MK is an early-warning signal of market entry, weeks before an entity or branch actually appears in the Trade Register.

source_name: CRM — related-entities / current status confirmations (поврзани субјекти, овластени лица, органи на управување)
why_relevant: Confirmations covering authorized persons, governing bodies and a person's ownership stakes in other entities, searchable by personal/company ID including foreign persons. This is the graph layer: it links a foreign vendor's MK entity to its local directors and to their other companies, exposing partnership and reseller structures.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Central Register of Macedonia (register #146)
why_relevant: Open, machine-readable mirror of MK entity records, usable for cross-border name matching (linking an MK subsidiary to its foreign parent) without touching the fee-based MK services. Coverage is partial and lags the official register, so it is a triage layer, not a source of truth.

source_name: UNODC GlobE Network — Directory of Open-Source Registries: North Macedonia
why_relevant: Curated inventory of MK official registries (company, beneficial ownership, and adjacent registers) with access notes. Fast way to enumerate registry-type sources beyond CRM that this cell should cover, maintained by an institutional actor rather than a marketing site.

source_name: Државен завод за статистика — Активни деловни субјекти по НКД Рев.2
why_relevant: The statistical business register derived from registry data: counts of active entities by NKD activity sector, municipality, size class and year. Provides the denominator for the MK IT / financial-service-activity vendor population and shows structural shifts (new-company formation slowdowns) that individual filings cannot.

source_name: Македонска берза (MSE) — issuer disclosures / СЕИ-НЕТ
why_relevant: Listed MK companies — notably the commercial banks that are the buyers in this market — file audited annual reports and price-sensitive announcements through the exchange's electronic disclosure system. Audited statements are richer than registry annual accounts and often name IT/payments investments, vendors and contracts in the notes.

source_name: МАСИТ — Стопанска комора за ИКТ, member directory
why_relevant: Chamber membership list is a ready-made actor map of MK IT companies (member pages exist per company, e.g. Bransys, InPlayer), and its governing-board composition names the locally significant firms. Each member name converts into an ЕМБС lookup in CRM, turning a soft directory into hard registry records.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national e-services catalogue, Central Registry institution page
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every CRM service, with fee and access conditions per service. Useful for planning what is legally obtainable and at what cost, and for detecting when a previously fee-based registry service becomes free/public.

source_name: Open Government Partnership — North Macedonia registry/beneficial-ownership commitments (MK0122, MK0144, MK0185)
why_relevant: Tracks the policy pipeline that determines future accessibility of this cell's core data: free public access to CRM basic data, and publication of beneficial owners (initially for public-procurement winners). Tells the collection plan when a paywalled source is about to open.

source_name: Schmidt & Schmidt — North Macedonia commercial register extracts & financial statements (procurement intermediary)
why_relevant: Documents, in English, what document types the MK register actually issues (extracts, annual accountancy statements, pledges, leasing, ownership certificates) and provides a paid channel to obtain them from abroad without an MK account. Useful as a fallback when CRM's own payment/account flow is impractical.

source_name: Registration-agent / law-firm guidance on подружница и претставништво на странско друштво
why_relevant: Explains the legal mechanics this cell depends on: a foreign company may open an MK branch only if registered at home; branch registration goes through CRM via an authorised registration agent; a branch must publish its annual account and audit report, while a претставништво (representative office) is not a legal entity and may not trade. That distinction determines whether a foreign vendor's MK presence produces registry financials at all.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — official site
why_relevant: Umbrella body of all MK banks and savings houses; site aggregates member roster, committees, events, ESG and financial-education programmes — the single best census of the banking demand side for vendors like Printec.

source_name: MBA — Собрание и комисии (committees/working groups)
why_relevant: Committee composition names the bank executives owning payments, cards, IT security and compliance agendas — early signal of procurement themes and who to approach; committee outputs precede regulation and tenders.

source_name: MBA e-Билтен (quarterly bulletin PDFs)
why_relevant: Quarterly association bulletin covering sector initiatives, digital projects, vendor/partner announcements and regulatory positioning — narrative detail rarely present in regulator statistics.

source_name: MBA — SKIBOR / референтни банки
why_relevant: Names the panel of reference banks for the SKIBOR benchmark — a clean, maintained list of the systemically active banks, useful as a de-facto tiering of the target account base.

source_name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce member directory
why_relevant: Ready-made census of MK ICT vendors (~80+ members, paginated ~13 pages) with individual company profile pages — the primary vendor/competitor list for banking IT, payments integrators and software houses.

source_name: MASIT news / position statements (news-mk, news-en)
why_relevant: Carries MASIT advocacy positions (e.g. formalisation of the economy via digital solutions), MoUs with foreign ICT chambers, and event announcements — surfaces partnerships and policy themes ahead of contracts.

source_name: MASIT governing bodies (Управен одбор / Надзорен одбор / Суд на честа)
why_relevant: Board composition maps the leading MK ICT firms and their executives (Aitonix, Makedonski Telekom, A1, MAK-System, Scale Focus, Ultra, Bransys, Edusoft, Datalab...) — a shortcut to the influential vendor tier.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија (Economic Chamber of North Macedonia)
why_relevant: Largest MK business chamber; hosts sector associations and 'групации' including financial organisations and non-banking financial companies, publishes news, events and position papers — a hub pointing to many actor lists.

source_name: Здружение на финансиски организации — Economic Chamber of NM
why_relevant: Cross-sector association uniting banks, insurers, pension fund managers, non-banking financial companies, leasing firms and savings houses — the broadest single membership frame for the MK financial demand side.

source_name: Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва — Economic Chamber of NM
why_relevant: Non-bank financial companies group: the fastest-moving fintech-adjacent segment (consumer lending, alternative finance) and a distinct buyer pool for payment and self-service technology.

source_name: Асоцијација на осигурително-брокерски друштва — Economic Chamber of NM
why_relevant: Insurance-broker association (formed 2011) — adjacent buyer segment for digital onboarding/document and payment technology; useful for widening the addressable-actor map beyond banks.

source_name: Alternative Financial Services Association of North Macedonia (АФД)
why_relevant: Trade body of alternative/non-bank lenders — a fintech-adjacent membership list and self-regulation source that identifies a buyer segment invisible in bank-only censuses.
